_comment: Facts the SAMAVESH Figma documentation pages assert about the code. Each entry pins one Figma TEXT node: `figma` is a snapshot of what it says, `expect` re-derives the same fact from the code. tools/figma-doc-parity/check.mjs fails when the two disagree. Every claim below was wrong on 2026-08-19 and is recorded here so it cannot rot again silently.

claims.where: AccessibilityBar — Documentation › 01 Anatomy › Government of India
claims.figma: Body/body-2 (14/20). Underlines on hover and focus only — on the words, not the launch glyph.

expect.hint: The bar's label type. Said Label/label-2 (12/16) until 2026-08-19, after the master had already moved to 14.
The underline is hover/focus-scoped and lives on the LABEL, not the anchor — otherwise text-decoration propagates onto the launch glyph.
There must be no RESTING underline — only :hover / :focus-visible on the label.
Verified correct on 2026-08-19 — pinned so it stays that way.
label-2 is 12px. The bar has been body-2 since the master moved to 14.
The spacing ladder is VALUE-NAMED. inline/s, inline/m, inline/l, padding/m and padding/2xl no longer exist.
If the stylesheet stops using a rung listed here, this row is describing spacing the bar no longer has.
Radius is value-named too; shape/xxs and shape/xs are dead names that rendered radius 0.
The bar standardised on the quieter inverse rule on 2026-08-19.
The estate targets 2.2 AA — see .claude/rules/standards-precedence.md. GIGW binds 2.1; 2.2 is a strict superset, so conforming to 2.2 satisfies it.

claims.figma: Every control is tabbable; focus renders inverse ink at 2px — never focus/ring (see 04).

expect.hint: This row said focus "uses focus/ring" until 2026-08-19, contradicting §04 on the same page. focus/ring is #0373DF and measures 1.37:1 on this bar's #005EB9 fill; inverse ink is 6.36:1.
If the bar ever starts using focus/ring, this claim — and the WCAG 1.4.11 conformance behind it — is void.

claims.figma: WCAG 2.2 · 2.5.8. Steppers are 24×24; the accessibility and language buttons 28×28, via transparent hit-area frames.

expect.hint: 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) is 24×24 at AA. 44×44 is 2.5.5 Enhanced (AAA) and is NOT claimed.
The seal has the name written round the ring, so the header says the same thing.
The panel title defaults to the name, not to an invitation.

This exact string sat in two JSDoc @default tags, in the props table on the web docs, in the Figma master and in this Identity panel long after the implementation moved on. Four surfaces agreed with each other and disagreed with the code.

claims.figma: Bot turns carry an avatar; user turns do not. Bubbles cap at 67% so the column never reads as a wall of text. Suggestions wrap and pack RIGHT, on the user’s side — each is a sentence they are about to say.

expect.hint: Suggestions sit on the user's side because pressing one becomes a user bubble, which lands hard right.
Without this the docs page's own `.ds-prose li + li` margin offsets every pill after the first by 8px.

claims.figma: A pill composer, the honest note, and Start over sharing the note’s row, hard right. It is the design system’s Button at variant="neutral" appearance="text" — no border, full ink, NO SIGNAL COLOUR. Hand-rolled it drifted into the estate’s rejection red for an action that is housekeeping.

expect.hint: The note and the button share one row; the button is not a word inside the paragraph.
It is a DS Button, not a hand-rolled control. Styled by hand it landed on its own weight scale instead of the system's.

No error ink on this control. Clearing a scripted routing transcript is housekeeping, not a failure, and a portal that spends its rejection red on housekeeping has none left when an application actually fails.
Base ink, not subtle: `subtle` resolves to the same text/muted as the disclaimer beside it, which made the one control in the footer the colour of body copy.

claims.figma: width 400, height 719 (a CAP, not a fixed height — the panel sizes to its content), launcher 84, bubbleMax 246, typingDot 5. Bound to the frames here and resolved by chatbot.css there, so neither side can move alone.

expect.hint: The library carried 6 while the master and the stylesheet both drew 5, because nothing was bound to it.
The stylesheet must RESOLVE these, not restate the numbers.
719 is the ceiling. Pinned there as a height, the opening state was 435px of white under the header — about 45% of the panel.

tokenTables._comment: Every --sa-* a component's WEB documentation page names in its token table must be referenced by that component's stylesheet — or declared in `via` as reached through another component.
